notes.title: Characters Movement Updates
notes.content:
Character movement updates:

[list]
[*] Stamina amount increased: Characters can now sprint for a longer period of time, perform more dodging rolls and more jumps
[*] Smaller enemies won't trigger a big hit reaction animation, letting the players have more control to avoid larger number of enemies swarming them.
[*] Update to the jump animation and its timing, making it more responsive.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: [*] Stamina amount increased: Characters can now sprint for a longer period of time, perform more dodging rolls and more jumps
[*] Smaller enemies won't trigger a big hit reaction animation, letting the players have more control to avoid larger number of enemies swarming them.
[*] Update to the jump animation and its timing, making it more responsive.

notes.title: Big Game Update
notes.content:
Big update! We made quite some changes in the game:

[list]
[*]Only one profile can be created instead of 3 in the past
[*]All achievements and leader boards are no longer tied to STEAM but are now global and cross-platform
[*]Added a new, 7th playable Character: Amira Lubya with a special ability of "Electro Homing missiles" (pretty awesome if you ask me!)
[*]Complete remake of Mission 1
[*]Heavily updated Mission 5
[*]More heavy overhaul of the missions will be on their way soon! stay tuned! Thanks again for the critics and feedback of some of our users!
[/list]

tags.feature: -Only one profile can be created instead of 3 in the past
-All achievements and leader boards are no longer tied to STEAM but are now global and cross-platform
-Added a new, 7th playable Character: Amira Lubya with a special ability of "Electro Homing missiles" (pretty awesome if you ask me!)
-Complete remake of Mission 1
-Heavily updated Mission 5
